item.text: {"0":"For Movies_and_TV, Industrial_and_Scientific, Electronics and CDs_and_Vinyl, change only interaction scoring to a jointly learned diagonal bilinear compatibility: s(h,i)=sum_d h_d*e_i,d*(1+0.5*tanh(a_d)), with a initialized to zero. This starts at dot-product scoring and learns bounded dimension weights that may suppress noisy compatibility channels without adding many parameters. Apply identically to training logits and candidate scoring. Preserve causal Transformer topology, input features, embeddings, history readout, loss, optimizer and seeds. Train one model per category; update the predictor writer and checkpoint loading while retaining routing."}
